articles.title: Antarctica's Blood Falls Mystery: New Genetic Clues Point to Ancient Seawater Origin
articles.summary: The eerie red waterfall in East Antarctica might be fed by ancient seawater trapped under a glacier for over a million years. New genetic analysis of microbes in the brine reveals a strong marine signature, challenging wind-blown theories.

articles.title: Ariana Grande Breaks Silence After Announcing Hiatus: 'I Cannot Wait' to See Fans
articles.summary: Following news that she'll step back from the public eye after her Eternal Sunshine Tour, Ariana Grande posted an optimistic message to fans ahead of her Chicago show. The decision comes amid relentless public scrutiny, particularly about her body.

articles.title: Fecal Transplants Show Promise for Insomnia in Early Trial
articles.summary: A small study found that fecal microbiota transplants (FMT) significantly improved sleep efficiency in chronic insomnia patients, from 79% to 93%. The treatment also reduced nighttime awakenings, with benefits lasting up to six months.
